# Prince Carlo Juguilon Portfolio

> Prince Juguilon's portfolio presents his software engineering profile, projects, experience, and technical writing. Public developer resources are available for agents and integrations.

## Developer resources

- [Prince Juguilon Developer Portal](https://prince.juguilon.com/developers): API documentation, quickstarts, MCP setup, authentication policy, sandbox guidance, and versioning policy.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://prince.juguilon.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of the public read-only portfolio API.
- [REST API index](https://prince.juguilon.com/api/v1): Links to all version 1 JSON resources.
- [Resume API](https://prince.juguilon.com/api/v1/resume): Structured resume data and the current PDF URL.
- [MCP server](https://prince.juguilon.com/api/mcp): Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol endpoint with read-only profile, project, and blog tools.
- [MCP server card](https://prince.juguilon.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Machine-readable MCP server metadata and tool list.
- [Authentication policy](https://prince.juguilon.com/auth.md): The API and MCP server are public and require no credentials.

## Content

- [Home](https://prince.juguilon.com/): Profile, experience, projects, setup, and contact details.
- [Blog listing](https://prince.juguilon.com/?tab=Blogs): Published engineering articles.
- [Sitemap](https://prince.juguilon.com/sitemap.xml): Index of public pages.

## Usage

All documented API operations and MCP tools are public, read-only, and non-destructive. API keys and OAuth are not required. Use https://prince.juguilon.com/api/v1 as the REST base URL and https://prince.juguilon.com/api/mcp for MCP Streamable HTTP.
